climate_definition: NASA POWER Jan-Oct mean temperature anomaly relative to 1984-1994, fixed window all years; not crop-specific growing season
baseline_definition: First archived zero-split plan [0,0,0] per Historical Train/Dev book; descriptive reference, not a fitted policy or continuous policy evaluation
deposition_definition: NL CLO trend implemented in nitrogen_helpers.py; annual empirical parameterization, not regional observations
